relations.name: coverphoto_book
relations.evidence: 200/200 cover photos: idBook == id, 1..200; /CoverPhotos/books/covers/{idBook} filters on it

notes: FakeRESTApi is an ASP.NET Core demo: all data is generated in memory from fixed rules; writes are echoed, never stored.
Books: 200, title 'Book N', pageCount N*100, publishDate = now - N days. Activities: 30, dueDate = now + N hours, completed = N even. Users: 10 (User N / PasswordN). CoverPhotos: 200, idBook = id.
Authors are regenerated randomly on EVERY request: each of the 200 books gets 2-4 authors (observed totals 588-608), ids sequential, names 'First Name N'/'Last Name N'.
password fields are server-generated demo fixtures, recorded unredacted on purpose (privacy.json allow_names).

Pipeline quirks in app.py: unsupported v= API version (Content-Type or Accept, any method) -> 400 UnsupportedApiVersion; Accept text/json -> text/json responses; 405 Allow lists; GET / -> 301 index.html (Swagger UI page served as recorded).

System.Text.Json: MaxDepth 32, lone surrogates refused, invalid literals quoted to the end of the body, relaxed escaping by Unicode category (all recorded). charset=utf-16/32 bodies -> empty 500 (recorded for utf-16 only).
Write budget: 20 real calls per write endpoint (recording + one parity run); POST/PUT Books and PUT Activities are exhausted.
